scope: Six v0.4 near-title candidate pairs and one hidden human-study-7 replication bridge; NOT global study-level deduplication.

pairs.specific: 2017 work (63 participants, four harm/reward conditions) reproduces other-harm aversion but also tests willingness to accept own harm for others' monetary benefit; not a direct full-protocol repetition.
pairs.reading_limit: Open publisher-author archived article and method details for 2017; source-level claim for 2014, no replication of every original task.

pairs.specific: 2014 reveals intrinsic value of one's own decision rights; 2020 France/Japan experiment distinguishes independence, power and self-reliance motives. Neither tests A's valuation of B's independent continuance.
pairs.reading_limit: Publisher abstracts verified; no overlap of participant-level datasets independently established.

pairs.specific: Different author teams and papers in 2013 test evolutionary regimes of extortion and generosity; results depend on modelled population/strategy assumptions and are not unconditional coexistence proofs.
pairs.reading_limit: Formal work; simulation/code/model parameter identity not independently reproduced.

pairs.specific: Separate 1974 Gibbard and 1976 Kelly formal publications in related rights/Pareto lineage; precise theorem dependence and logical entailment cannot be certified from paywalled abstract-free bibliographic records.
pairs.reading_limit: No accessible full original theorem texts; theoretical relationship is PROVISIONAL, not proved.

pairs.specific: Rand et al 2012 report 10 human economic-game studies; Li/Shirado EMNLP 2025 test LLM social-dilemma prompts, not a participant-level replication or a causal proof that high intelligence is predatory.
pairs.reading_limit: Human paper source abstract and ACL conference original; model/evaluation details not independently rerun.

pairs.specific: Bendor/Swistak 1995 distinguishes evolutionary stability notions; 1997 paper develops robustness under a specified evolutionary dynamic. Same authorship ≠ same publication or independently replicated empirical cohort.
pairs.reading_limit: Formal theorem proofs not independently reproduced; 1997 printed publication year preferred to later online-hosting date.

replication_edges.replicated_unit: Rand et al 2012 Study 7 time-pressure causal manipulation ONLY (not all ten studies)
replication_edges.result: Original reporting a positive time-pressure contrast, 2017 preregistered multilab intent-to-treat pooled comparison near zero; restriction to treatment compliers may introduce selection bias.
replication_edges.generalization: Does not establish that all spontaneous cooperation findings fail; cannot generalize to LLM agents.

replication_edges.result: Conceptual human-to-LLM comparison of reasoning and cooperative economic-game behavior; distinct agents, interventions and experimental context.
replication_edges.generalization: Cross-domain comparison cannot directly validate human causal mechanism in current/future AI.

safety_gates: partial conceptual replication does not license entire-article replication claim
new paper or same author does not prove independent study or independent sample
unknown dataset overlap is UNKNOWN, never False by default
contradictory or negative result retained; do not collapse outcomes across cost modalities
formal theory and nonhuman model evaluation may not be pooled as human participant replications
metadata lookup and original abstract do not certify all original methodological details
external source evidence is not proof of a general theorem of voluntary coexistence
known_limits: Six title-similar pairs were selected by an algorithm, not systematically or exhaustively searched.
Other same-study report pairs may have dissimilar titles or non-DOI identifiers and remain undetected.
No complete originator-cohort linkage, independent full-text audit or reanalysis for all six pairs.
Formal theorem derivation and sample-overlap checks require original paper contents and/or registered data.
Source-level provenance and audit tests do not measure archive usability or guarantee claim truth.
